diseases.name: Epilepsy (unprovoked seizures)
diseases.inv: EEG, MRI brain; glucose and electrolytes at presentation.

diseases.name: Provoked (acute symptomatic) seizure
diseases.inv: Glucose, electrolytes, toxicology, CT head; treat the cause.

diseases.name: Stroke / TIA
diseases.inv: Time-critical: urgent CT/MRI brain, glucose, ECG; stroke pathway.
diseases.tool: FAST/BE-FAST are screening aids for stroke recognition, not diagnoses.
diseases.alt: Hypoglycaemia, Bell palsy, migraine aura, seizure with Todd paralysis

diseases.name: Guillain-Barre syndrome
diseases.inv: Urgent neurology review; nerve conduction studies; lumbar puncture; monitor breathing.
diseases.alt: Myelopathy, hypokalaemia, myasthenia gravis, polio-like illness

diseases.name: Spinal cord compression
diseases.inv: Emergency MRI spine; urgent neurosurgical review.
diseases.alt: GBS, transverse myelitis, mechanical back pain

diseases.name: Myopathy / muscle disease
diseases.inv: CK, thyroid function, EMG; consider steroid/drug causes.

diseases.name: Myasthenia gravis
diseases.inv: Acetylcholine receptor antibodies, repetitive nerve stimulation, chest CT for thymoma.

diseases.name: Hypokalaemia / metabolic weakness
diseases.inv: Serum potassium, other electrolytes, glucose, thyroid function.

diseases.name: Vestibular neuritis
diseases.inv: Clinical; HINTS-type bedside exam by trained clinician.

diseases.name: Bell palsy
diseases.inv: Clinical; exclude stroke, ear and parotid causes.
diseases.alt: Stroke, Ramsay Hunt syndrome, tumour, diabetes

flags.text: Sudden weakness, facial droop, speech or vision loss: possible stroke, time-critical
Leg weakness with back pain / numb level / bladder trouble: possible cord compression, emergency
Weakness rising from the feet with tingling: possible Guillain-Barre, monitor breathing
Vertigo with double vision, slurred speech or incoordination: possible posterior circulation stroke
Seizure with fever, head injury or hypoglycaemia risk: check glucose and look for CNS infection
